name: Narita International Airport

runway.v: runway A, 4,000 m long and 60 m wide; runway B is currently 2,500 m by 60 m

curfew.v: no take-offs or landings from midnight to 06:00 on runway A and from 23:00 to 06:00 on runway B, except in emergencies; a short flexible extension applies only for delays the airline could not avoid
curfew.quote: 24時から6時までの離着陸（ A滑走路）、23時から6時までの離着陸（B滑走路）で下記の事例に該当する場合、緊急事態（従来取り決め）が適用されます。

slots.quote: Slot application is necessary for flying business jets in Narita International Airport.

handling.v: Premier Gate, an exclusive terminal for business jets with its own customs and immigration
handling.quote: Premier Gate is an exclusive terminal for business jets with CIQ facilities.

missing: location (distance from Tokyo not stated on official pages read)
notes: Curfew times come from the NAA Japanese curfew page (no page date; it cites the change of 27 Oct 2019). Flexible operation: runway A 24:00-24:30, runway B 23:00-24:00, only for unavoidable delays. Runway B also has a limit of 10 movements between 22:00 and 23:00. Narita's runway B extension and new runway C are planned; re-check the curfew page before publishing. Handling_list is for internal use only (the website names no companies). NAA also asks operators to send aircraft, insurance and other documents before flying in (naa-bj-private-docs); no deadline is stated.
